strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Enter in the direction of a confirmed break of that level after a lower-timeframe close above/below it with elevated volume, or on a pullback retest of the broken level holding as support/resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry/breakout candle (described as below the breakout candle or below the retest entry candle for longs). Look for at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and trail the stop to break-even or into profit as the move continues.

strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: When price briefly breaks above the pre-market high or below the pre-market low but then quickly reclaims/fails the level, enter in the opposite direction of the failed break after that reclaim confirmation. result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct executable skeletons: continuation through/after a confirmed breakout of the pre-market level, and reversal after a liquidity sweep reclaim. Within the continuation skeleton, direct breakout and break-retest are compatible entry variants sharing the same management.
